Climate Change, Directed Innovation, and Energy Transition: The Long-run Consequences of the Shale Gas Revolution
abstract: We investigate the short- and long-term effects of a natural gas boom in an economy where energy can be produced with coal, natural gas, or clean sources and the direction of technology is endogenous. In the short run, a natural gas boom reduces carbon emissions by inducing substitution away from coal. Yet, the natural gas boom discourages innovation directed at clean energy, which delays and can even permanently prevent the energy transition to zero carbon. We formalize and quantitatively evaluate these forces using a benchmark model of directed technical change for the energy sector. Quantitatively, the technology response to the shale gas boom results in a significant increase in emissions as the US economy is pushed into a “fossil-fuel trap” where long-run innovations shift away from renewables. Overall, the shale gas boom reduces our measure of social welfare under laissez-faire, whereas, combined with carbon taxes and more generous green subsidies, it could have increased welfare substantially.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了天然气繁荣在一个能源可由煤炭、天然气或清洁能源生产、且技术方向内生的经济体中的短期和长期效应。短期内，天然气繁荣通过诱导对煤炭的替代而减少碳排放。然而，天然气繁荣抑制了针对清洁能源的创新，这会延迟甚至可能永久阻碍能源向零碳转型。我们利用能源部门定向技术变迁的基准模型，对这些作用力进行了形式化和定量评估。定量结果显示，页岩气繁荣引发的技术响应导致碳排放显著增加，美国经济因此陷入“化石燃料陷阱”，长期创新转向远离可再生能源。总体而言，在自由放任条件下，页岩气繁荣降低了我们衡量的社会福利；而若与碳税和更慷慨的绿色补贴相结合，则可能大幅提高福利。

title: Learning, Diversity and Adaptation in Changing Environments: The Role of Weak Links
abstract: Adaptation to dynamic conditions requires a certain degree of diversity. If all agents take the best current action, learning that the underlying state has changed and behavior should adapt will be slower. Diversity is harder to maintain when there is fast communication between agents, because they tend to find out and pursue the best action rapidly. We explore these issues using a model of (Bayesian) learning over a social network. Agents learn rapidly from and may also have incentives to coordinate with others to whom they are connected via strong links. We show, however, that when the underlying environment changes sufficiently rapidly, any network consisting of just strong links will do only a little better than random choice in the long run. In contrast, networks combining strong and weak links, whereby the latter type of links transmit information only slowly, can achieve much higher long-run average payoffs. The best social networks are those that combine a large fraction of agents into a strongly-connected component, while still maintaining a sufficient number of smaller communities that make diverse choices and communicate with this component via weak links.
abstract_zh: 对动态条件的适应需要一定程度的多样性。如果所有主体都采取当前最佳行动，那么对潜在状态已发生改变、行为应随之调整这一点的学习将会变慢。当主体之间沟通迅速时，多样性更难维持，因为他们会迅速发现并追随最佳行动。我们使用基于社会网络的（贝叶斯）学习模型探讨这些问题。主体能从强连接的对象中快速学习，并且可能有动机与其强连接的对象协调行动。然而，我们表明，当潜在环境变化足够快时，任何仅由强连接构成的网络在长期中的表现都只比随机选择略好。相比之下，结合强连接与弱连接的网络（后者只能缓慢传递信息）则可以实现高得多的长期平均收益。最佳社会网络是那些将大量主体整合为一个强连通分量、同时又保留足够多的较小社群的网络，这些小社群做出多样化的选择，并通过弱连接与该强连通分量进行沟通。

Mirage on the Horizon: Geoengineering and Carbon Taxation Without Commitment
abstract: We show that, in a model without commitment to future policies, geoengineering breakthroughs can have adverse environmental and welfare effects because they change the (equilibrium) carbon taxes. In our model, energy producers emit carbon, which creates a negative environmental externality, and may decide to switch to cleaner technology.A benevolent social planner sets carbon taxes without commitment. Higher future carbon taxes both reduce emissions given technology and encourage energy producers to switch to cleaner technology. Geoengineering advances, which reduce the negative environmental effects of the existing stock of carbon, decrease future carbon taxes and thus discourage private investments in conventional clean technology. We characterize the conditions under which these advances diminish -rather than improve -environmental quality and welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们表明，在没有未来政策承诺的模型中，地球工程（geoengineering）的突破可能产生不利的环境和福利效应，因为它们会改变（均衡）碳税。在我们的模型中，能源生产者排放碳，这会产生负的环境外部性，并可能决定转向更清洁的技术。一个仁慈的社会计划者在没有承诺的情况下设定碳税。未来碳税提高，既能在给定技术条件下减少排放，也会激励能源生产者转向更清洁的技术。地球工程的进步降低了现有碳存量的负面环境影响，但会使未来碳税下降，从而抑制企业对传统清洁技术的私人投资。我们刻画了这些进步反而恶化环境质量和福利，而非改善它们的条件。

title: Informational Braess' Paradox: The Effect of Information on Traffic Congestion, July-
abstract: To systematically study the implications of additional information about routes provided to certain users (e.g., via GPS-based route guidance systems), we introduce a new class of congestion games in which users have differing information sets about the available edges and can only use routes consisting of edges in their information set. After defining the notion of an information-constrained wardrop equilibrium (ICWE) for this class of congestion games and studying its basic properties, we turn to our main focus: whether additional information can be harmful (in the sense of generating greater equilibrium costs/delays). We formulate this question in the form of an informational Braess’ paradox (IBP), which extends the classic Braess’ paradox in traffic equilibria and asks whether users receiving additional information can become worse off. We provide a comprehensive answer to this question showing that in any network in the series of linearly independent (SLI) class, which is a strict subset of series-parallel networks, the IBP cannot occur, and in any network that is not in the SLI class, there exists a configuration of edge-specific cost functions for which the IBP will occur. In the process, we establish several properties of the SLI class of networks, which include the characterization of the complement of the SLI class in terms of embedding a specific set of networks, and also an algorithm that determines whether a graph is SLI in linear time. We further prove that the worst-case inefficiency performance of ICWE is no worse than the standard Wardrop equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 为系统研究向特定用户提供额外路线信息（例如通过基于GPS的路线引导系统）的影响，我们引入了一类新的拥塞博弈，其中用户对可用路段拥有不同的信息集，且只能使用由其信息集中路段构成的路线。在为这类拥塞博弈定义信息受限的Wardrop均衡（ICWE）并研究其基本性质后，我们转向主要关注点：额外信息是否可能有害（即导致更高的均衡成本或延误）。我们将这一问题表述为信息性Braess悖论（IBP），它扩展了交通均衡中经典的Braess悖论，并询问获得额外信息的用户是否可能境况变差。我们对此给出了全面的回答：在线性独立系列（SLI）网络类中（这是串并联网络的严格子集），IBP不会发生；而在不属于SLI类的任何网络中，都存在一组边特定成本函数的配置，使IBP发生。在此过程中，我们建立了SLI网络类的若干性质，包括通过嵌入一组特定网络来刻画SLI类的补集，以及一个能在线性时间内判定图是否为SLI的算法。我们进一步证明，ICWE的最坏情形低效程度不差于标准Wardrop均衡。

Income and Health Spending: Evidence from Oil Price Shocks
abstract: Health expenditures as a share of GDP in the United States have more than tripled over the past half-century. A common conjecture is that this is a consequence of rising income. We investigate this hypothesis by instrumenting for local area income with time series variation in oil prices interacted with local oil reserves. This strategy enables us to capture both partial equilibrium and local general equilibrium effects of income on health expenditures. Our central income elasticity estimate is 0.7, with 1.1 as the upper end of the 95% confidence interval, which suggests that rising income is unlikely to be a major driver of the rising health expenditure share of GDP.
abstract_zh: 在过去半个世纪中，美国医疗支出占GDP的比重已增长至原来的三倍以上。一种常见的推测认为，这是收入增长的结果。我们以当地石油储量与石油价格的时间序列变化的交互项作为当地收入的工具变量，来检验这一假设。该策略使我们能够同时捕捉收入对医疗支出的局部均衡效应和局部一般均衡效应。我们的核心收入弹性估计值为0.7，其95%置信区间上限为1.1，这表明收入增长不太可能是医疗支出占GDP比重上升的主要驱动因素。

The Environment and Directed Technical Change
abstract: This paper introduces endogenous and directed technical change in a growth model with environmental constraints. A unique final good is produced by combining inputs from two sectors. One of these sectors uses "dirty" machines and thus creates environmental degradation. Research can be directed to improving the technology of machines in either sector. We characterize dynamic tax policies that achieve sustainable growth or maximize intertemporal welfare. We show that: (i) in the case where the inputs are sufficiently substitutable, sustainable long-run growth can be achieved with temporary taxation of dirty innovation and production; (ii) optimal policy involves both “carbon taxes” and research subsidies, so that excessive use of carbon taxes is avoided; (iii) delay in intervention is costly: the sooner and the stronger is the policy response, the shorter is the slow growth transition phase; (iv) the use of an exhaustible resource in dirty input production helps the switch to clean innovation under laissez-faire when the two inputs are substitutes. Under reasonable parameter values and with sufficient substitutability between inputs, it is optimal to redirect technical change towards clean technologies immediately and optimal environmental regulation need not reduce long-run growth.
abstract_zh: 本文在具有环境约束的增长模型中引入了内生的定向技术变迁。一种最终产品由两个部门的投入组合生产。其中一个部门使用“肮脏”机器，从而造成环境退化。研发可以定向于改进任一部门的机器技术。我们刻画了实现可持续增长或最大化跨期福利的动态税收政策。我们表明：(i) 在投入之间具有足够替代性的情形下，可通过对“肮脏”创新和生产的暂时性征税实现可持续的长期增长；(ii) 最优政策同时包括“碳税”和研发补贴，从而避免过度依赖碳税；(iii) 干预延迟代价高昂：政策反应越早、越强，经济增长放缓的转型阶段就越短；(iv) 当两种投入为替代品时，在自由放任条件下，将耗竭性资源用于“肮脏”投入的生产有助于转向清洁创新。在合理的参数取值和投入之间充分替代的条件下，最优的做法是立即将技术变迁转向清洁技术，且最优环境规制未必会降低长期增长。
